variables.name: initializationData
variables.comment:
* List of buffers containing the codec-specific data to be provided to the decoder. * *

See {@link Format#initializationData}.

variables.name: nalUnitLengthFieldLength
variables.comment: The length of the NAL unit length field in the bitstream's container, in bytes.

variables.name: width
variables.comment: The width of each decoded frame, or {@link Format#NO_VALUE} if unknown.

variables.name: height
variables.comment: The height of each decoded frame, or {@link Format#NO_VALUE} if unknown.

variables.name: pixelWidthHeightRatio
variables.comment: The pixel width to height ratio.

variables.name: codecs
variables.comment:
* An RFC 6381 codecs string representing the video format, or {@code null} if not known. * *

See {@link Format#codecs}.

methods.name: public static HevcConfig parse(ParsableByteArray data) throws ParserException
methods.comment:
* Parses HEVC configuration data.
   *
   * @param data A {@link ParsableByteArray}, whose position is set to the start of the HEVC
   *     configuration data to parse.
   * @return A parsed representation of the HEVC configuration data.
   * @throws ParserException If an error occurred parsing the data.

methodNames: public static HevcConfig parse(ParsableByteArray data) throws ParserException
